page_title: ARS 2-1 BRE | Arsenal v Brentford 09/03/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+10' Robert Jones is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+10' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) expertly controls the pass inside the penalty area and shoots, but it's inadvertently blocked a defender.
90+9' Nathan Michael Collins (Brentford) is given a fully deserved yellow card.
90+7' Mikkel Damsgaard (Brentford) manages to dispossess his opponent of the ball, but he commits a foul in the process and the referee blows his whistle.
90+5' Mikel Arteta decides to make a substitution. Martin Odegaard will be replaced by Thomas Partey (Arsenal).
90+3' After the VAR review the referee signals NO PENALTY, play can continue.
90+2' Referee Robert Jones makes the VAR signal and is going to check whether it’s a penalty for Arsenal. Let’s see what happens!
90+1' One of the Arsenal players is in on goal but gets upended by the defender in the box. That could be a penalty, but the ref says NO! Play continues.
90+1' Thomas Frank prepares a substitution. Zanka is replaced by Mikkel Damsgaard (Brentford).
90+1' Here comes a substitution. Vitaly Janelt is given a rest as he is replaced by Saman Ghoddos (Brentford).
90' We will have 7 min. of added time.
86' 2 - 1 It's a goal! Kai Havertz (Arsenal) bursts into the box to get on the end of a whipped in cross from Ben White and scores magnificently from close range into the top right corner. 2:1.
84' Ben White (Arsenal) clips an inviting cross into the box, but there's no one in a position to get on the end of it. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Brentford.
83' The current number of shots on target for both teams is 15:9. Shots on target – 5:4.
80' The attendance for today's match is 60331.
79' It's time for a substitution. Oleksandr Zinchenko (Arsenal) comes on in place of Jakub Kiwior.
79' Substitution. Leandro Trossard makes his way off the pitch and Reiss Nelson (Arsenal) comes on as his replacement.
79' Neal Maupay (Brentford) makes a run beyond the last defender, but he's offside.
78' Thomas Frank has decided to substitute Frank Onyeka and he is replaced by Yegor Yarmolyuk (Brentford).
78' Here comes a substitution. Neal Maupay (Brentford) is brought on as a substitute for Yoane Wissa.
77' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates. The ball is easily cleared out of danger.
76' Martin Odegaard (Arsenal) sends the ball into the penalty area from a free kick just outside the box. The goalkeeper rises and gathers the ball.
74' Declan Rice (Arsenal) latches onto a short pass just on the edge of the box and shoots. The effort beats the keeper but comes back off the right post. Close!
74' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) floats the ball in from the corner but it's intercepted.
73' Yoane Wissa (Brentford) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Robert Jones had an easy-decision to make.
72' Mathias Jensen (Brentford) takes the corner, but the opposition's defence is ready and clears the ball to safety.

71' Aaron Ramsdale makes a superb save to deny a header which was nodded towards the roof of the net by Nathan Michael Collins (Brentford) after a cross from the side. Brentford have been awarded a corner kick.
70' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Gabriel Jesus (Arsenal) comes onto the pitch so that Jorginho can be given a rest.
67' Leandro Trossard (Arsenal) hits a rasping drive from inside the box after latching onto a lofted pass, but it's straight at Mark Flekken and he makes a comfortable save.
66' PENALTY APPEAL after Kai Havertz (Arsenal) goes down under a challenge from the defender. All players chase the referee but he's not interested in the penalty claim. Play continues.
64' Ivan Toney (Brentford) sends a cross into the box, but Aaron Ramsdale comes off his line to gather the ball.
63' Leandro Trossard (Arsenal) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
63' Martin Odegaard (Arsenal) serves up a nice cross, but Mark Flekken punches the ball away.
60' Declan Rice (Arsenal) is first to the rebound but his shot is blocked. Wow, what an escape there for the opposition.
60' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) takes the corner which is cleared.
60' Ben White (Arsenal) meets a cross and produces a header towards the left side of the goal, but one of the defending players blocks the effort.
59' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) is heading toward the corner flag to take the set piece.
58' Declan Rice (Arsenal) whips in a cross from the corner, but Mark Flekken is well positioned and punches the ball away. The referee signals a corner kick to Arsenal.
58' Jakub Kiwior (Arsenal) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. The referee points to the corner flag and Arsenal will take a corner.
57' Jakub Kiwior (Arsenal) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Mark Flekken, who smothers the ball.
56' Brentford fail to score from a corner as Aaron Ramsdale (Arsenal) leaps to collect the ball.

55' Ivan Toney (Brentford) latches on to a low pass and without any hesitation whatsoever releases a first-time rocket towards the top left corner. Unfortunately for him, his long-distance effort is blocked by Aaron Ramsdale who makes a glorious save! Brentford have a corner.
54' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) puts a cross into the box from the corner but there is no panic from the opposition and they easily clear.
54' Nothing comes of the resulting corner from Bukayo Saka (Arsenal). The defence is alert and manages to cut it out.
52' The corner from Declan Rice (Arsenal) is hurriedly cleared.
50' The resulting corner from Mathias Jensen (Brentford) is cleared by the opposition's defence.
50' Yoane Wissa (Brentford) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being well blocked by one of the defenders. Now Brentford have a corner.
49' Martin Odegaard links up with Bukayo Saka (Arsenal), who fires just over the bar from the edge of the box.
48' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety.
47' Martin Odegaard (Arsenal) got the ball on the edge of the box and fired in a first-time shot on goal, but his effort floated well over the bar. High, wide and not at all handsome.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+6' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+4' 1 - 1 Goal! Yoane Wissa (Brentford) seizes on the loose ball after a huge error from Aaron Ramsdale and finds the back of the net from inside the box. 1:1.
45+2' Kristoffer Ajer (Brentford) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
45+2' Kai Havertz (Arsenal) is rightly booked by the referee because it could not have been anything other than a yellow card.
45' There will be a minimum of 3 min. of added time.
44' Martin Odegaard (Arsenal) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
43' Kai Havertz (Arsenal) had a good opportunity when he latched on to a cross from the wing, but his strike wasn't accurate at all and the ball went well over the bar.
41' Leandro Trossard (Arsenal) had a good opportunity from long range. His shot was directed towards the bottom left corner, but Mark Flekken was alert and made a comfortable save.
38' Declan Rice picks out Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) unmarked inside the box, but he blazes the ball well over the bar.
35' Kai Havertz (Arsenal) is deemed to be in an offside position by the linesman and it looks like it is the right decision despite being a very close call.
34' Problems for Thomas Frank as Christian Norgaard (Brentford) is not able to play anymore. His injury is too serious and Mathias Jensen replaces him.
32' Vitaly Janelt (Brentford) commits a foul and Robert Jones immediately signals a free kick.
30' The game is interrupted now, Christian Norgaard (Brentford) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
29' Robert Jones interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Martin Odegaard (Arsenal).
27' Declan Rice sends over a penetrating corner which finds the head of Gabriel (Arsenal), but his effort from close range is disappointing and goes high over the bar.
27' Declan Rice (Arsenal) will deliver the ball into the penalty box from a corner kick.
26' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked. The linesman makes the right call and Arsenal will have a corner.
24' Kai Havertz (Arsenal) receives a short pass and produces a low effort from mid-range towards the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper is alert and makes a routine save.
22' Kristoffer Ajer (Brentford) sends a long ball in, but Aaron Ramsdale comfortably gathers the ball.
21' Zanka (Brentford) has tested the patience of referee Robert Jones and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.

19' 1 - 0 It's in the back of the net! Ben White sends a superb cross into the box. Declan Rice (Arsenal) latches on to it and from near the penalty spot powers a header inside the left post, leaving Mark Flekken beaten. He displayed his eye for goal there - excellent finish. The score is 1:0.
18' Kai Havertz (Arsenal) collects a pass and finds himself in a good position to strike from the edge of the box, but his attempt is blocked.
16' Leandro Trossard (Arsenal) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
16' Ivan Toney (Brentford) rises highest from the corner to head at goal, but his effort towards the middle of the goal is comfortably saved by the goalkeeper.
16' Vitaly Janelt (Brentford) will take the corner.

15' Ivan Toney (Brentford) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack. Brentford force their opponents to concede a corner.

14' Martin Odegaard (Arsenal) sends over a cross from the side into the penalty area in order to find one of his teammates, but he fails and the opportunity goes begging. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Brentford.
13' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Brentford was in an offside position.

12' Keane Lewis-Potter (Brentford) sends a lofted pass from the resulting free kick, but fails to hit the ball properly and his effort goes out of play. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Arsenal.
11' Brentford are awarded a free kick from a dangerous position.
10' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Gabriel (Arsenal) was quite harsh and Robert Jones didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
8' Aaron Ramsdale (Arsenal) sends a long ball forward to Bukayo Saka, but he put too much power and the chance is gone. The ball goes out of play and Brentford will have a goal kick.
7' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) passes the ball from the edge of the box in order to find his teammate, who is in a good scoring position, but the defender blocks the pass and spanks the ball to safety.
4' Frank Onyeka (Brentford) receives a yellow card from the referee as expected.
4' The defence had a hard time blocking out the strike from Yoane Wissa (Brentford). He didn't hesitate and finished from outside the box right after he had received a pass from his teammate.
2' The ball is whipped in from the corner by Declan Rice (Arsenal), but one of the defenders gets it clear.
2' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) sprays a pass out to Leandro Trossard, but he can't beat his man inside the box. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Arsenal.
1' The first half has started.
The players are on the pitch and Brentford will have the kick-off.
The referee of today's match will be Robert Jones.
